A CONTINUING INQUIRY

Music becomes

a place.

Across the archive, the screen shifts from a four-sided

volume to an outdoor presence and a collection of suspended

planes. The medium remains translucent; the relationship

between image, musician and audience keeps changing.

01 / ATTENTION

When should the image step back?

Explore how visual intensity can support the music while leaving the

performer at the centre of attention.

02 / VIEWPOINT

Does every seat share the experience?

Compare sightlines, transparency and image legibility from different audience

positions.

03 / UNDERSTANDING

What is remembered?

Use future audience conversations and observation to understand what

viewers notice, feel and take away.

ALBUM NOTES

Concept diagrams and visual studies are adapted

from the original Echo Space proposal.

Performance photographs are selected from the

six supplied event folders.

Research concerns and intended effects are

presented as design questions. No audience

outcome measurements are claimed.
